Based on the provided document notes, here are the distinct obligations of the client, obligations of the supplier, and the specified fines, along with line citations, contradictions, and gaps:

### Obligations of the Client (המזמין)
1. Pay the consideration within 45 days from receiving a lawful tax invoice (L3, L13, L33, L43, L53, L63, L73, L83, L93, L103, L123, L133, L143, L153, L161, L171, L183).
2. May inspect the quality of service at any time, subject to prior coordination (L10, L20, L30, L40, L50, L70, L80, L90, L100, L110, L120, L130, L190, L200).

### Obligations of the Supplier (הספק)
1. Maintain an available stock/inventory of spare parts for the factory service in Kiryat Gat (L4, L14, L24, L54, L64, L74, L84, L94, L104, L114, L144, L154, L164, L174, L184, L194).
2. Ensure any changes in the scope of service are made in writing and signed by both parties (L5, L15, L25, L35, L45, L95, L105, L115, L125, L135, L163, L173, L175, L185, L195).
3. Arrive at the warehouse in Ashdod within four hours for an urgent call, and within two days for a regular call (L6, L16, L26, L36, L46, L56, L66, L86, L96, L106, L116, L126, L136, L146, L156, L176, L186, L196).
4. Coordinate in advance with the site manager any work at the Kiryat Gat factory that requires a shutdown (L7, L9, L17, L19, L27, L29, L59, L69, L79, L89, L99, L107, L117, L119, L139, L149, L159, L169, L177, L179, L189, L197).
5. Keep secret any information received within the framework of the engagement (Note attributes this to "Both parties / Supplier") (L8, L38, L48, L58, L68, L78, L86, L98, L128, L138, L148, L158, L168, L178, L186, L188).
6. Appoint one customer manager to coordinate relations and communication with the client (L9, L11, L19, L21, L29, L31, L39, L41, L51, L61, L91, L101, L111, L121, L131, L141, L151, L181, L191, L201).
7. Insure its employees with employers' liability insurance and third-party insurance (L17, L25, L27, L35, L37, L45, L47, L57, L67, L77, L107, L115, L127, L137, L147, L157, L167, L197).
8. Perform a monthly maintenance visit at the logistics center in Holon and submit a report on the visit (L20, L22, L30, L32, L40, L42, L52, L62, L72, L80, L82, L112, L122, L132, L142, L152, L162, L170, L192, L202).

---

### Fines (Cases and Amounts)
* **Holon Logistics Center:**
  * Delay in responding to an urgent service call: 1,000 NIS per case (L7)
  * Use of non-original spare parts: 9,750 NIS per case (L34)
  * Failure to submit the monthly maintenance report on time: 3,250 NIS per case (L87)
  * Breach of on-site safety instructions: 5,500 NIS per case (L166)
  * Failure to perform preventive maintenance on time: 12,000 NIS per case (L113)
  * Failure to document a service call in the system: 18,500 NIS per case (L60)
  * Leaving waste on-site after work: 14,250 NIS per case (L193)
  * Failure to meet repair times specified in the service appendix: 20,750 NIS per case (L140)

* **Ashdod Warehouse:**
  * Shutdown of the cooling system beyond four hours: 1,500 NIS per case (L81)
  * Replacement of a technician without prior notice: 8,000 NIS per case (L28)
  * Use of non-original spare parts: 3,750 NIS per case (L161)
  * Loss of client equipment: 10,250 NIS per case (L108)
  * Working without a valid entry permit: 16,750 NIS per case (L55)
  * Failure to document a service call in the system: 12,500 NIS per case (L187)
  * Delay in responding to an urgent service call: 19,000 NIS per case (L134)

* **Kiryat Gat Factory / Plant:**
  * Shutdown of the cooling system for more than four hours: 4,500 NIS per case (L18)
  * Use of non-original spare parts: 6,750 NIS per case (L97)
  * Failure to perform preventive maintenance on time: 9,000 NIS per case (L177)
  * Loss of client equipment: 13,250 NIS per case (L44)
  * Failure to document a service call in the system: 15,500 NIS per case (L124)
  * Delay in responding to an urgent service call: 22,000 NIS per case (L71)

* **Tel Aviv Offices:**
  * Failure to meet repair times specified in the service appendix: 2,750 NIS per case (L12)
  * Replacing a technician without prior notice: 5,000 NIS per case (L92)
  * Loss of client equipment: 7,250 NIS per case (L171)
  * Breach of safety instructions on-site: 11,500 NIS per case (L39)
  * Working without a valid entry permit: 13,750 NIS per case (L118)
  * Delay in responding to an urgent service call: 16,000 NIS per case (L198)
  * Cooling system shutdown exceeding four hours: 22,500 NIS per case (L145)

* **Haifa Branch:**
  * Replacing a technician without prior notice: 2,000 NIS per case (L155)
  * Failure to submit a monthly maintenance report on time: 6,250 NIS per case (L23)
  * Breach of safety instructions on site: 8,500 NIS per case (L102)
  * Failure to perform preventative maintenance on time: 15,000 NIS per case (L49)
  * Working without a valid entry permit: 10,750 NIS per case (L182)
  * Leaving waste on site after work: 17,250 NIS per case (L129)
  * Failure to meet the repair times determined in the service appendix: 23,750 NIS per case (L76)

* **General / Other Fines:**
  * Delay in the supply of spare parts: 5% of the order value per week of delay (L65)
  * Leakage of client customer information under supplier responsibility: 48,000 NIS, in addition to any other remedy (L150)

---

### Contradictions and Gaps Pointed Out in the Notes
* **Contradiction/Ambiguity in Confidentiality:** The confidentiality obligation (Obligation #5) is listed ambiguously as applying to "Both parties / Supplier" (L8, etc.), which creates a gap regarding whether the client is formally bound by the exact same confidentiality standard under this specific clause, or if it only applies unilaterally to the supplier.
* **Gaps in Scope for Supplier Obligations:** While the fines section details site-specific infractions and maintenance duties across multiple branches (Holon, Ashdod, Kiryat Gat, Tel Aviv, Haifa), the general "Obligations of the Supplier" section explicitly mentions routine duties for *only* some of these locations (e.g., inventory in Kiryat Gat, monthly visits in Holon, response times in Ashdod). This leaves a structural gap where specific operational obligations for Tel Aviv, Haifa, and general branches appear to be missing from the general obligations list and only surface via the penalty clauses.
